author: Ryan safi
review_text: eSewa kebal euta app matra nabhai Nepali prabidhi ko euta brand ho. Yadi yesle yi dui pramukh kshetra Antarrashtriya bhuktani ra teebra surakshya pranali ma kaam garne ho bhane, yo biswa bazar ma pratispardha garna sakne euta utkrishta 'Super App' bannechha. Hami chahanchhau ki sansar ko junasukai kunama bhaye pani Nepali le garba ka sath bhanna sakoos "Ma sanga eSewa chha."
